W. N. P. Barbellion, The Journal of a Disappointed Man.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/w-n-p-barbellion/the-journal-of-a-disappointed-man

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- W. N. P. Barbellion, the author, died 1919.
- H. G. Wells, the writer of the introduction, died 1946.

First publication of the text used: 1919 (SE colophon: 'The Journal of a Disappointed Man was published in 1919 by W. N. P. Barbellion.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1919, before 1931. Under the United States 95-year rule, every publication of 1930 or earlier has been in the public domain since 1 January 2026 at the latest.
- Country of origin: the facts do not point to any country as the country of first publication. The possible countries for an English text by these authors are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths, so an unknown country, or a simultaneous publication in two of them, changes nothing. The last person to die died in 1946, so the text entered the public domain in each of these countries by 1 January 2017.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
